hero.lead: I'm a software engineer with 3+ years building enterprise software, now for U.S. clients at Allata. I work with AI coding agents every day and I'm training in agentic AI and MCP.

workflow.title: How I work with AI
workflow.intro: On client work I build with Claude Code. Around it I put together a setup, so each session starts with what it needs and stays inside the project's rules.

items.title: Context per project
items.text: Each project has its own knowledge base, written as a wiki the agent reads (the LLM Wiki pattern). A session starts with the project context and the task board loaded, so I don't explain the codebase again each time.

items.title: Hooks as guardrails
items.text: Hooks are scripts that run at fixed points of a session. The rules that have to hold every time run there as code, so they don't depend on the model remembering an instruction.

items.title: Skills and plugins
items.text: Work I repeat becomes a skill: reading a work item, reviewing a pull request, writing up a change, closing a task. I write the steps and the checks once and reuse them.

items.title: Tuned over time
items.text: I keep adjusting what gets loaded, when and how much. The goal is better output with fewer tokens.

workflow.note: This is the setup I use with clients. RAG, LangChain, LangGraph and n8n are training and personal projects so far.

items.text: Software engineer on enterprise projects for a U.S. client. I work with client stakeholders every day on estimates, technical decisions and code reviews. I also set up the AI coding workflow used on the project: Claude Code with a knowledge base per project, custom hooks, skills and plugins.

Delivered full stack features for U.S. enterprise clients within established architectures, using AI tools across the development process. Flagged risks early and kept communication clear with the engineering team and client stakeholders.

Built backend services with Python/Django, Java/Spring Boot, Kotlin and .NET, and Vue.js frontends, with MongoDB as the main database. Also developed custom Odoo ERP modules and helped with ETL processes and Power BI reports.

Built enterprise applications with C#/.NET and Angular, and managed PostgreSQL and SQL Server databases. Combined an accounting and administration background with data analysis to find and implement improvements across several internal systems.

wallstreetpro.title: WallStreetPro
wallstreetpro.text: A swing trading analysis system that runs on Claude Code. Once a week it reads live chart data from TradingView through an MCP server, checks a short rule set and answers BUY or NO BUY with entry, stop and exit date. It never places an order.
wallstreetpro.text2: I backtested the rules over 5,533 simulated trades on 446 tickers, from 2015 to 2026. They had no edge over the market, so I cut the guardrails from 10 to 5 and kept what the data supported.
wallstreetpro.tableCaption: Pass conditions, written before the run
wallstreetpro.tableNote: Result: 0 of 4. Version 5 kept 5 of the 10 rules.

dockwitcher.title: Dockwitcher
dockwitcher.text: Logistics platform for transport and loading docks, built during the Full Stack Bootcamp at Hotaka iKhodi. It puts fleet and dock management in one place, with real-time tracking and notifications.
dockwitcher.alt: Dockwitcher screen listing warehouse receptions with their status

chocolate.title: Chocolate shop e-commerce
chocolate.text: Freelance project from 2023. An online store for a chocolate shop: customers browse and buy, members get benefits, and the owners manage stock, promotions and sales reports. Angular front end, with a Node.js and Express API on MySQL.
chocolate.alt: Home page of the chocolate shop store

pallets.title: Pallet management system
pallets.text: A .NET application for pallet logistics. It tracks pallet movements and condition, the carriers and clients involved, and produces inventory reports.
pallets.alt: Control panel of the pallet management system, with monthly movement charts

pasta.title: Pasta Studio, launch landing page
pasta.text: Landing page I designed and built for the April 2026 opening of Pasta Studio, an Italian restaurant in Córdoba, Argentina. Vite and vanilla JavaScript, with a live countdown, scroll-snap navigation and Google Maps, made to be opened from a QR code on a phone. The repo holds my version; the owners have changed the site since.
pasta.alt: Pasta Studio landing page with a countdown to the opening
